mapper.select: SELECT u.id, u.nickname, h.created_at AS hidden_at FROM user_hidden_creator h JOIN users u ON u.id = h.creator_id WHERE h.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY h.created_at DESC, u.id DESC
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users WHERE id = #{id} AND is_active = true)
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM user_hidden_creator WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND creator_id = #{creatorId})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_hidden_creator (user_id, creator_id) VALUES (#{userId}, #{creatorId}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM user_hidden_creator WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND creator_id = #{creatorId}
